summary: Built a fresh db from the committed cache, cfb doctor exited 0, and ran all seven golden years under Keener. The five must-match years PASS. 2003 is contested: evidenced #1 LSU 13-1, with USC #2. 2017 is contested: evidenced #1 Alabama 13-1, with Georgia #2. One blocking finding: 2019 now ranks Ohio State #2 above Clemson, which a round-1 change caused.

tests_run.command: CFB_DB_PATH=$S/cfb.sqlite3 uv run cfb ingest --years 1998-2025 && CFB_DB_PATH=$S/cfb.sqlite3 uv run cfb rate

findings.summary: 2019 top-3 order changed: Ohio State now #2 ahead of Clemson (was LSU, Clemson, Ohio State at base). #1 is still LSU, so the must-match year passes, but the change comes from this round's margin cap.
findings.evidence: base e5aeddc: LSU 0.1123, Clemson 0.1041, Ohio State 0.1039; branch: LSU 0.1120, Ohio State 0.1044, Clemson 0.1037
